label: Funk-rock / groove sale
blurb: Basse-batterie soudées, guitare qui griffe, groove physique.
core: gritty groove rock, bass and drums welded

grafts.label: Trompette sourdine
grafts.phrase: a muted trumpet line, breathy and distant

grafts.label: Basse fuzz
grafts.phrase: a fuzzed-out bass that growls through the mix

grafts.label: Clavinet wah
grafts.phrase: a clavinet run through a wah pedal, quacking on the off-beats

grafts.label: Percussions latines
grafts.phrase: congas and timbales pushing the groove forward

far.label: Arpèges 8-bit
far.phrase: low-bit tracker-style arpeggios and crunchy 8-bit sample hits

far.label: Séquenceur analogique
far.phrase: a pulsing analog sequencer locked to the bass

far.label: Sitar psyché
far.phrase: a droning sitar figure bending over the groove

extra: the pocket sits slightly behind the beat
every rest is part of the groove

presets.label: Groove 70s habité
presets.note: Riff funk-rock 70s, basse en avant, tension soul.
detail: a strutting seventies funk-rock riff doubled by bass, soulful tension, organ swells

presets.label: Western soul massif
presets.note: Groove lent et lourd, cuivres, ambiance western.
detail: a slow heavy stomp, spaghetti-western guitar twang, horn blasts at the peaks

presets.label: Funk électrique
presets.note: Funk nerveux, claviers vintage, grain électrique.
detail: a jittery clavinet loop, analog synth squelches, funk with electric grit

presets.label: Afro-funk hypnotique
presets.note: Guitares imbriquées, polyrythmie, cuivres répétés comme un mantra.
detail: interlocking afrobeat guitars, hypnotic polyrhythmic percussion, horn riffs repeating like a mantra
